plan.title: ArcTools
plan.sub: The trading and launch stack for Arc
plan.vo: This is ArcTools. One stack for trading, launching and building on Arc, the USDC-native chain by Circle. Here is everything it does today, in two and a half minutes.

plan.title: Terminal
plan.sub: Live pairs from 25 launchpads, quick buy, charts
plan.vo: The Terminal streams every new pair on Arc from twenty-five launchpads: trending, new pairs, top volume, with live charts, risk flags and one-click Quick Buy.

plan.title: Sniper bot
plan.vo: The Sniper bot on Telegram buys at any cost the second a token goes live. Positions, PnL cards, auto-snipe rules, copy trading, deployer-dump guard and a referral program paying twenty-five percent.

plan.title: Buy bot & Insider index
plan.sub: Group alerts, @ARCTrends, whale and cluster intelligence
plan.vo: The Buy bot posts every buy into your group and ranks tokens on ARCTrends. Behind it, the Arc Insider index tracks whales, insider clusters and dev wallets in real time.

plan.title: ArcToolsPad
plan.sub: Launch a token in one minute, bonding curve to Uniswap
plan.vo: ArcToolsPad launches a token in one minute. Bonding curve, then automatic graduation to Uniswap. Thirty USDC for an instant launch, one percent on every trade.

plan.title: ArcLocker
plan.sub: Lock LP or team tokens, public proof pages
plan.vo: ArcLocker locks liquidity or team tokens with a public proof page. No admin key over your assets. Fifty USDC per lock.

plan.title: ArcPredict
plan.sub: BTC, ETH, SOL up-or-down rounds every two minutes
plan.vo: ArcPredict: Bitcoin, Ethereum and Solana, up or down, every two minutes. Winners split the pool, prices come from four exchanges and land on-chain.

plan.title: ArcTools Market
plan.sub: Hire for your token, USDC escrow, on-chain reviews
plan.vo: The Market: hire for your token and pay only when it is delivered. USDC waits in escrow, disputes are split with a public note, reviews live on-chain.

plan.title: Bridge, Swap, Buy with card
plan.sub: CCTP bridge, aggregator swaps, MoonPay on-ramp to ARCT
plan.vo: Move money in: bridge USDC with CCTP, swap through the aggregator at half a percent, or buy ARCT straight from a card.

plan.title: ArcClaim & ArcOrders
plan.sub: USDC pay links, limit orders and stop-losses
plan.vo: Send USDC as a link with ArcClaim. Set limit orders and stop-losses with ArcOrders, executed on-chain.

plan.title: x402 API
plan.vo: Developers get the same data through the x402 API: pay per call in USDC, no keys, no subscriptions, running natively on Arc.

plan.title: ArcOne Android
plan.sub: Trading wallet, Terminal, Predict and Market in your pocket
plan.vo: All of it fits in ArcOne, the Android app: wallet, Terminal, Predict and Market, updated straight from the site.

plan.title: ARCT
plan.sub: Every fee buys back and burns ARCT
plan.vo: Every fee across the stack flows to one treasury that buys back and burns ARCT. Over fifty-eight million tokens are gone already, and the counter is public.

plan.title: arctools.fun
plan.vo: ArcTools. Built on Arc, running today. Start at arctools dot fun.
